advisoryFindings.title: R4 path assertion is overly prescriptive about path.join style
advisoryFindings.improvement: Loosen the regex to also accept equivalent path expressions such as a single literal `"experimental/workflow/skills"` or `path.join(..., "experimental", "workflow", "skills")` with arbitrary leading segments, so the test enforces the path semantics rather than a specific quoting/segmentation style.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current regex matches the conventional path.join style used elsewhere in this codebase, so a compliant implementation will satisfy it; this is purely a robustness improvement.

advisoryFindings.title: R8 verifies upgrade output artifacts but does not exercise `sdd-forge upgrade` exit code
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider invoking `sdd-forge upgrade` from the test (or relying on a separate e2e test) so that R8's `exit 0 after the rename` clause is actively verified rather than inferred from pre-existing generated artifacts; at minimum, document that the spec depends on upgrade being run as part of implementation.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: R6 frames the spec-local coverage around `upgrade output` (artifact content), and the combination of R2 (no `@templates/` in skill sources) and R8 (artifacts contain expanded `Core Principle` content with no `@templates/`) transitively detects an unrun or failed upgrade; the runtime exit code check belongs to test-execute/final-regression phases.

advisoryFindings.title: R6 file-count threshold is fragile if tests/unit/templates/ is itself renamed
advisoryFindings.improvement: Either widen the candidate list to include likely renamed locations (e.g. tests/unit/skills/*) or lower the threshold, so the assertion does not flip to failure purely because shared regression tests were relocated alongside the src rename.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Today's candidate list has 11 entries and only the three under tests/unit/templates/ are likely to move, leaving exactly 8 — still meeting the threshold; this is a future-proofing concern.
